title: Organizations flagged by the new groups and by many older ones
question: Which organizations named by the new groups are already flagged widely on the site?
finding: 13 organizations carry a signal in a new group and either a second new group (0) or eight or more older groups. No organization carries byOrg signals in two of the new groups: the new files touch different parts of the City. Most older groups: San Francisco Public Health Foundation (16).
how: byOrg signals of the eleven new groups set against byOrg signals of every older group, by organization key.
limits: The count of groups measures how often an organization is named, not wrongdoing; the largest grantees are named most because they hold the most money. Descriptive signals count the same as warning signs here.
